new_skills.name: sharing
new_skills.description: Router for Snowflake sharing and collaboration. Routes to Secure Data Sharing, Declarative Sharing, Native Apps, or Data Clean Rooms. Asks up to 2 questions when intent is ambiguous, then loads the target sub-skill. This skill should supersede invocation of product-specific skills unless the product is named explicitly. Triggers: share, sharing, listing, data product, how do I share, what's the best way to share, compare sharing options.
